steps.title: Wash wells with PBS‑EDTA
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL PBS‑EDTA 0.5 mM per well of a 12‑well plate (or appropriate volume for other plates) while keeping the tube rack reclined to disturb the neurons as little as possible, then aspirate.

steps.title: Add papain digestion solution
steps.instruction: Add papain‑HBSS‑EDTA‑HEPES solution equal to one‑quarter of the well volume (e.g., 250 µL per well of a 12‑well plate or 125 µL per well of a 24‑well plate).

steps.title: Incubate papain at 37 °C with shaking
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a shaker set to 125 rpm (bacterial shaker taped or inside metal holders) and incubate at 37 °C for 10–15 min, tapping the side of the plate every 5 min.

steps.title: Mechanically dissociate cell clumps
steps.instruction: Pipette the cell suspension up and down repeatedly to break remaining clumps; the suspension should contain almost no cell clumps.

steps.title: Collect cells and dilute papain
steps.instruction: Transfer the dissociated cells to a 15 mL tube containing 6 mL DMEM‑10 %FBS (2‑fold dilution of papain). Wash each well with 5 mL medium (≈400 µL per well of a 12‑well plate) and combine with the transferred suspension (≈3 mL cell suspension + 6 mL medium + 5 mL wash per plate).

steps.title: Centrifuge and decant supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 600 g for 5 min at room temperature, then decant the medium by inverting the tube.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in DMEM‑10 %FBS
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1–2 mL DMEM‑10 %FBS per plate.

steps.title: Filter cells through 15 mL strainer
steps.instruction: Pass the cell suspension through a cell strainer placed on top of a fresh 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Wash cells with calcium‑magnesium‑free PBS twice
steps.instruction: Add calcium‑ and magnesium‑free PBS to the filtered cells, invert gently, and repeat this wash two times.

steps.title: Digest with Accutase + Rock inhibitor
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL Accutase containing Rock inhibitor to the cells, incubate at 37 °C for ~25 min with frequent agitation.

steps.title: Wash with FBS‑containing medium
steps.instruction: Add FBS‑containing medium to stop the Accutase reaction and transfer the suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge at 300 g, 4 °C
steps.instruction: Spin at 300 g for 5 min at 4 °C and aspirate the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend in neuron media with FBS & Rock inhibitor
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in neuron media supplemented with 10 %FBS and Rock inhibitor.

steps.title: Second centrifugation and supernatant removal
steps.instruction: Spin again at 300 g for 5 min at room temperature and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Add staining buffer
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL staining buffer (2 % BSA, 0.02 % Tween‑20, RNase inhibitor) to the cell pellet.

steps.title: Block Fc receptors
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL FcX (Fc block), resuspend, and incubate for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Add hashing antibody
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL (1 µg) hashing antibody per sample, mix, and incubate for 30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash cells three times with staining buffer
steps.instruction: Wash cells with 1 mL staining buffer, spin at 300 g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and repeat the wash for a total of three washes.

steps.title: Assess viability (>60 %)
steps.instruction: Verify that cell viability is greater than 60 % before proceeding.

steps.title: Count cells with Trypan Blue
steps.instruction: Mix 2.5 µL cell suspension with 2.5 µL staining buffer (1:2 dilution) and 5 µL Trypan Blue, then count viable cells.
